summary.text: Mary Murphy is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 27 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against independent Tim Coffin.
Murphy is a small business owner and former software executive for a Fortune 500 company, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Mary Murphy has served on the board of trustees for Rivier University and St. Joseph Hospital and has been affiliated with the NRA, according to Ballotpedia.
Murphy defeated Susan Kane in the Hillsborough 27 general election on November 5, 2024.
